::: {.page-lede}
This page is a developing home for reproducible materials connected to my methodological research and teaching. Public links will be added as code, simulation workflows, and instructional materials are prepared for release.
:::

## Bayesian Multilevel Modeling

Planned materials include prior-calibration examples for variance components, sensitivity-analysis templates, cross-software prior translation examples, and simulation workflows for small-sample multilevel models.

## Measurement and SEM

Planned materials include sparse ordinal CFA simulation examples, fit-index calibration workflows, examples for category collapsing and model-fit evaluation, and measurement invariance and DIF examples.

## Teaching Materials

Planned materials include multilevel modeling examples in R, Bayesian modeling walkthroughs, reproducible analysis templates, and model diagnostics and reporting checklists.

## Methods and Software

**Methods:** Bayesian multilevel and longitudinal modeling; CFA/SEM and item-response modeling; measurement invariance and DIF; complex survey analysis; simulation; causal inference; machine learning and NLP for measurement applications.

**Software:** R, Python, Stan, Mplus, SAS, SPSS, Winsteps, Git, and LaTeX.
